description_en: Marco MT is an e-commerce translation model trained on over 1 billion high-quality bilingual sentence pairs, continuously optimized for e-commerce-specific terminology such as brands, models, materials, and attributes. It supports translation between more than 100 language pairs (including bridged translations), especially Chinese-English, Chinese-multilingual, and English-multilingual translations. It supports language detection for 24 language directions. If you do not specify the source language, automatic detection is performed
description_zh: Marco MT是10亿+ 高质量双语句对训练出的电商领域翻译模型，针对电商领域特有的品牌、型号、材质、属性等术语进行不断优化。支持100多种(含桥接)语向间的互译，尤其是中英互译、中文与多语言的互译，英文与多语言的互译。支持 24 个语向的语种识别，如您不设置源语言可实现自动识别
kebab_example: aliyun aidge prepaid-text-translate --target-language zh --source-text-list Hello_world --region cn-hangzhou
name: PrepaidTextTranslate

parameters.help_en: The source language code. This parameter is optional. If not specified, the language is automatically detected. You can pass auto for language detection
parameters.help_zh: 源语言代码，选填。不传入则自动检测语种。可传 auto 做语种识别
parameters.name: source_language

parameters.help_en: The target language code. This parameter is required. More than 100 language directions are supported. For details, refer to the supported language directions list
parameters.help_zh: 目标语言代码，必填。支持 100 多种语向，具体见支持语向列表
parameters.name: target_language

parameters.help_en: The list of texts to translate. This parameter is required. The total character length cannot exceed 50,000, and the list length cannot exceed 50
parameters.help_zh: 待翻译文本列表，必填。总字符长度不超过 50000，List 长度不超过 50
parameters.name: source_text_list

parameters.help_en: The intervention glossary ID. This parameter is optional. The glossary must be created separately in the console, and its ID must be provided. If the glossary ID is empty, the translation result is not modified
parameters.help_zh: 干预词表 ID，选填。需要在前台单独创建并提供其 ID。如果提供的干预词表 ID 为空，则翻译结果将不会被修改
parameters.name: glossary

parameters.help_en: The format type of the source text. This parameter is optional. Supports text (plain text format) and html (web page format, preserving HTML tags)
parameters.help_zh: 源文本的格式类型，选填。支持 text（纯文本格式）和 html（网页格式，保留 HTML 标签）
parameters.name: format_type

parameters.help_en: The format of the translation text. html (web page format. This setting processes both the source text and translated text in HTML format) or text (text format. This setting processes both the source text and translated result as plain text without format processing)
parameters.help_zh: 翻译文本的格式，html（ 网页格式。设置此参数将对待翻译文本以及翻译后文本按照 html 格式进行处理）、text（文本格式。设置此参数将对传入待翻译文本以及翻译后结果不做文本格式处理，统一按纯文本格式处理
parameters.name: translate_scene

parameters.help_en: The business scenario identifier. This parameter is optional. Valid values: e-commerce-title, e-commerce-description, e-commerce-chat, e-commerce-cpv, novel, game. If not specified or an invalid value is passed, the general translation strategy is used by default
parameters.help_zh: 业务场景标识，可选。合法值：e-commerce-title、e-commerce-description、e-commerce-chat、e-commerce-cpv、novel、game；未传或传错时默认使用通用翻译策略
parameters.name: biz_name

Code.description_en: The response code. Returns "success" for normal calls
Code.description_zh: 响应代码，正常调用时返回"success"
Code.title_en: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Code.title_zh: 错误码，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

Data.description_en: The translation result data, including the translation list and usage information
Data.description_zh: 翻译结果数据，包含翻译列表和用量信息

Translations.description_en: The translation result list. Each element corresponds to a translation result for an entry in the input text list
Translations.description_zh: 翻译结果列表，每个元素对应输入文本列表中的一条翻译结果

Characters.description_en: The character count of the source text

UsageMap.description_en: The usage information, including the input character count
UsageMap.description_zh: 用量信息，包含输入字符数等

Message.description_en: The error message. Returns "Success" for normal calls. Returns specific error information for exceptions, such as "The parameters contain sensitive information. Try other input."
Message.description_zh: 报错信息。正常调用时返回"Success"，异常时返回具体错误信息，例如"参数中包含敏感信息，请尝试其他输入"
Message.title_en: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。
Message.title_zh: 错误信息，正常调用时，不会返回该参数。

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, used to identify a unique request call
RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用来识别唯一一次请求调用

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call is successful. true indicates success. false indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 是否调用成功。true 代表成功，false 代表失败
Success.title_en: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
Success.title_zh: 是否调用成功：true：调用成功。false：调用失败。
